name: minimax-code-cycle-plugin
description: Evidence-gated multi-role delivery for MiniMax Code. Adds a Cycle skill plus an MCP server that exposes evidence verification, candidate freeze, AST knowledge graph, and scoped graph queries. The plugin enforces real evidence before any candidate is approved: hash-chained audit ledger, frozen candidates, mandatory verification commands, and an independent final arbiter that evaluates the original user request verbatim.
author: Gianluca Iannotta
exampleQueries: Run /cycle setup, then /cycle doctor, then /cycle run auto on this project
